operations.description: Marks a DatabaseInstance to be deleted. The DatabaseInstance will be set to the DELETED state for 20 days, and will be purged within 30 days. The default database cannot be deleted. IDs for deleted database instances may never be recovered or re-used. The Database may only be deleted if it is already in a DISABLED state.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] firebasedatabase projects locations instances delete [PATH] v 1beta [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Gets the DatabaseInstance identified by the specified resource name.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] firebasedatabase projects locations instances [PATH] v 1beta [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Lists each DatabaseInstance associated with the specified parent project. The list items are returned in no particular order, but will be a consistent view of the database instances when additional requests are made with a `pageToken`. The resulting list contains instances in any STATE. The list results may be stale by a few seconds. Use GetDatabaseInstance for consistent reads.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] firebasedatabase projects locations instances list [PATH] v 1beta instances [PARAMS] access alt callback deleted fields key oauth page parent pretty print protocol quota show size token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] database instances list response

operations.description: Disables a DatabaseInstance. The database can be re-enabled later using ReenableDatabaseInstance. When a database is disabled, all reads and writes are denied, including view access in the Firebase console.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] firebasedatabase projects locations instances disable [PATH] v 1beta name disable [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] database disable instance request

operations.description: Enables a DatabaseInstance. The database must have been disabled previously using DisableDatabaseInstance. The state of a successfully reenabled DatabaseInstance is ACTIVE.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] firebasedatabase projects locations instances reenable [PATH] v 1beta name reenable [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] database instance reenable request

operations.description: Restores a DatabaseInstance that was previously marked to be deleted. After the delete method is used, DatabaseInstances are set to the DELETED state for 20 days, and will be purged within 30 days. Databases in the DELETED state can be undeleted without losing any data. This method may only be used on a DatabaseInstance in the DELETED state. Purged DatabaseInstances may not be recovered.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] firebasedatabase projects locations instances undelete [PATH] v 1beta name undelete [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] database instance request undelete

operations.description: Requests that a new DatabaseInstance be created. The state of a successfully created DatabaseInstance is ACTIVE. Only available for projects on the Blaze plan. Projects can be upgraded using the Cloud Billing API https://cloud.google.com/billing/reference/rest/v1/projects/updateBillingInfo. Note that it might take a few minutes for billing enablement state to propagate to Firebase systems.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] firebasedatabase projects locations instances create [PATH] v 1beta instances [PARAMS] access alt callback database fields id key oauth only parent pretty print protocol quota token type upload user validate xgafv [SCHEMA]
